name: API Orchestrator - Sample: JSONPlaceholder
description: JSONPlaceholder REST sample: one service plus five REST endpoints, working out of the box for testing.
project_description: API Orchestrator - Sample: JSONPlaceholder installs a ready-to-use REST integration against jsonplaceholder.typicode.com — one api_orchestrator_service plus five endpoints (e.g. jp_list_posts) that work with no configuration, ideal for trying out the module (drush api-orchestrator:request jp_list_posts). hook_uninstall removes the sample service and endpoints. Requires api_orchestrator, api_orchestrator_integration_samples and api_orchestrator_mirror. Part of the API Orchestrator project.
